meta.title: Optimize interrupt polling
meta.body_summary: Optimize CPU interrupt polling by prefetching interrupt flags into a pending mask to reduce MMU calls, with unit tests and a CPU benchmark.

perf_labels.notes: Small refactor reduces MMU reads in interrupt handling; merged despite negligible benchmark regression (~2%) accepted as noise or trade-off for readability.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 206 changed lines, this is a small edit by absolute volume. It is a focused interrupt optimization in a CPU emulator, merged by the author despite a benchmark showing a negligible regression, likely for code clarity and potential future benefit.

review_details.concern_detail: The CPU benchmark before this PR was ~1.86ms and after ~1.90ms, indicating a tiny regression; coderabbitai suggested adding more granular interrupt-focused benchmarks but no human reviewer raised blocking concerns.
review_details.performance_claim: Reducing MMU reads by prefetching interrupt flags improves efficiency, though benchmark shows slight regression.
review_details.antipattern_addressed: repeated_mmu_calls (prior code read IF repeatedly per check; now precomputed pending mask)

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Low-level CPU emulator interrupt optimization requires understanding of Game Boy's IF/IE registers and cycle-accurate behavior; Agent succeeded in a small-scope refactor with no human rejection.

detection_detail.code_reading: The maintainer recognized repeated MMU reads in interrupt handling and proposed a pending mask to eliminate them.
detection_detail.benchmark: A Criterion CPU cycle benchmark was added to compare performance; the results showed a negligible regression (~2%) which was accepted.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Benchmark command and before/after numbers are provided, but no setup beyond cargo bench; results show a slight regression, suggesting noise or non-significant change.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: The PR merged despite the benchmark showing a 0.04ms increase, as the regression was considered negligible and possibly within measurement noise; no revert or further optimization was pursued.

core_change_summary.description: In src/cpu.rs, interrupt flags (IF) are read once per cycle and combined with IE to form a pending mask, eliminating repeated MMU reads in halt release and interrupt servicing logic. Unit tests for interrupt behavior and a Criterion CPU benchmark are added.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Cargo.toml adds the new benchmark target; src/gb.rs gets a comment for empty ROM loading; benches/cpu.rs implements the isolated CPU cycle benchmark.
change_trajectory: Initial commit refactored interrupt checks and added benchmark.
Subsequent commits refined polling logic, added unit tests, documentation, and fetch method updates.

review_signals.summary: Provided nitpick suggestions (extract constants, avoid any) and recommended additional interrupt-focused benchmarks; no blocking changes requested.
Initially rate limited, then generated a walkthrough, sequence diagram, and finishing touch prompts; non-blocking.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with initial interrupt optimization and benchmark.
CodeRabbit bot provided non-blocking review with nitpicks and benchmark suggestions.
Maintainer added unit tests, documentation, and further refactorings.
PR self-merged by author after ~27 hours with no human reviewer interaction.
